name: Cubert son of Daere
text: Cubert son of Daere is a hero of Welsh story. Culhwch names him to Arthur in the long roll of heroes in Culhwch ac Olwen. The mention sits inside the famous court list of the tale. Modern commentators suggest Cubert may match the Irish lord Cú Roí mac Dáiri. Patrick Sims-Williams published that comparison in a study of 1982.

attributes.attribute: a Welsh hero of the court list
proposed counterpart of Cú Roí mac Dáiri

okr.objective: Cubert son of Daere holds the Welsh hero of the court list and his Irish double.
